title: Pulse Console visual upgrade

visual: Full driver-console visual pass after lifecycle controls are simplified
Stronger ride hierarchy, cleaner spacing, fewer glass panels and internal labels
Use route/fare/status as the dominant information
Retain Pulse night visual identity and current map functionality
Make active ride and incoming request states visually distinct at a glance
map: Evaluate MapLibre GL JS as an upgrade path from the current Leaflet presentation
Support route line, pickup/destination markers and active-trip focus when routing data is available

acceptance: Console looks like a purpose-built driver app rather than an admin dashboard
Incoming request, Scheduled and active ride are immediately distinguishable
No functional regression in QR, Inbox, map, shift, or rider lifecycle
